build_pubmed_search.description: Build a PubMed search for a MeSH heading or supplementary concept, with its exact name and the right search tag: optionally narrowed to subheadings or to articles where it is a main topic, without the headings below it, or widened with its entry terms as title and abstract words. Returns the query and a link that runs it; the PubMed integration's search takes the query as it is.

description: Look up MeSH, the Medical Subject Headings the U.S. National Library of Medicine indexes PubMed with: the official heading for a subject, its tree numbers and place in the hierarchy, synonyms (entry terms), definition and allowed subheadings (qualifiers), plus supplementary concept records for chemicals, drugs and rare diseases with the headings they map to, and drugs' pharmacological actions. Use it to tag content with standard headings, expand a search with synonyms and narrower headings, or build a precise PubMed query. Every action reads; no account or API key required.
